Guides / Friends & trading / Friends

Friends

Friend codes, gifts, sending money, visits, battles, reactions and the Trainers board.

Friends need you logged in with Discord (Settings). Your save always stays on your PC.

  • Add a friend with their 6-letter friend code (Friends tab; click yours to copy it).
  • Gifts: send one a day to each friend ("send all" does everyone and tells you how it went, e.g. "Sent 120 gifts · 2 already had today's"). Open up to 10 a day. A gift holds 5 Great Balls or 3 Ultra Balls, plus 1–3 Rare Candy (40%), 6–15 Candy of a party family (35%) or $1,000–$3,000 (25%), and sometimes a Gift Egg (11%) or a Costume Egg (1%).
  • Send money: a friend can receive up to $1,000,000 a day from everyone together.
  • Visit a friend's PC: their card, showcase (six they pick), team, rarest Pokémon and finds.
  • Friend battles: your party against theirs with the same auto battle engine as Gyms (held items, roles, one Mega each).
  • Reactions: react to friends' rare finds: Hype!, Jaw drop, Sheesh, Royalty, Love it, GG, LOL, Salty, Eyeing it, Make an offer (for this one).
  • Trainers board: rank everyone by catches, encounters, hatches, Shinies, Voids, Prismatics, perfect IVs, playtime, Pokédex or badges.
  • Favourite friends: tap the star on a friend to keep them at the top of every sort and of the raid party invite list.
  • Cheers: cheer a friend's rare find with the heart in Friends' finds (once per find); see who cheered yours on the Reactions page.
  • Gifts, trades, raids, cheers and friend battles together earn friendship points, which raise your trade level with that friend (see Trading).
